rounds.reason: Initial complete proxy reconstruction for first render feedback.
rounds.report:
Representation level: L1 (proxy). CineRecon Three.js sampled-frame baseline (native inspect-revise protocol).

Subjects (observed in all 24 samples): two male fighters on a burning, coin-strewn wooden ship deck. Fighter A ("Nate", blue-grey T-shirt, dark jeans, holster) is kept on image-left in almost every shot; fighter B ("Rafe", black shirt/trousers) on image-right or centre. Each is a proxy humanoid (box pelvis/torso, sphere head + hair cap, cylinder upper/lower arms and legs, box feet) with two-bone IK on arms and legs driven by per-key hand/foot targets, plus torso lean/twist/side and root yaw/tilt (tilt used for lying on the deck). Two swords (blade box, guard, grip) attach to the right hand or lie on the floor according to a timeline.

Environment: 30 m wood-plank floor with a seeded procedural plank+coin DataTexture (emissive coins), coin heaps, dark walls, pillars with panels, two staircases and a railing, patterned crates, a metal rack used in the final close-ups, additive flame cones (deterministic flicker), flickering orange point lights, fog, drifting embers.

Timeline/camera (inferred from samples; cut times between samples are estimates): 0-1.55 over-shoulder, Rafe's downward swing staggers Nate; 1.55-2.62 top-down, Nate on his back with Rafe over him, sword raised; 2.62-3.65 rotated top-down, Rafe kneels and stabs the deck, Nate rolled aside; 3.65-4.7 low shot behind Nate getting up while Rafe's legs walk in; 4.7-8.85 over-shoulder: swords, clash (~5.75) and swords dropped, fist fight, Nate charges Rafe (~8.3); 8.85-9.9 higher angle, Nate doubled over, Rafe grabbing; 9.9-12.0 close behind them grappling; 12.0-13.05 high angle, both bent recovering swords; 13.05-20.3 over-shoulder sword duel with Rafe lunging; 20.3-21.4 whip-pan of Nate spinning; 21.4-22.4 close shot behind Nate, Rafe facing camera; 22.4-24.02 reverse close-up, Nate (left) shoving Rafe (right, back to camera) by a rack. Characters are re-placed across hard cuts where the reference staging requires it. Motion between keys is smoothstep interpolation of absolute keyed states; update() is absolute-time and deterministic.

Observed vs inferred: positions/poses at the 24 sample times are estimated from the images; in-between actions (strike timing, sword drop/pick-up, cut points) are inference. Identity of the low figure at 12.5 s and the pose at 9.4 s are uncertain.

Feedback: none received yet (initial render candidate). Framing and subject image sizes are unverified.
